    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Epipolar Geometry（对极几何）介绍</span>
    

</a>

	    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        Epipolar Geometry（对极几何）介绍.
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>Epipolar Geometry（对极几何）是三维重建的数学基础，用于描述三位场景投影到两张图片上的点之间存在的几何关系。</p>
<p><img alt="61" width="479" height="290" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206000640876-641826613.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>如图所示，O1,O2分别表示相机的中心点，P表示三维场景中的顶点，p和p'表示顶点P点投影到两个相机平面的像素点，e和e'则表示O1和O2连线与相机平面的交点。O1，O2，P三个点确定的平面叫Epipolar plane(极平面)，O1，O2的连线叫Baseline(基线)，Baseline与相机平面的交点叫做epipole(极点)，在图中为e和e',pe和p'e'叫做Epipolar line（极线），这些术语经常在不同的paper里出现，应该熟悉。虽然我们不知道P点的具体位置，但是P点在两个相机平面的投影需要满足一定的约束条件，即与p点对应的p'点应该在p'e'这条直线上，这就减少了搜索的范围。</p>
<p>一.Homography matrix(单应性矩阵)</p>
<p><img alt="62" width="245" height="59" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206000709255-873831470.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>Homography matrix表示两个平面上的点之间的变换，下面举几个例子：</p>
<p><img alt="63" width="320" height="167" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206000740166-438738387.jpg" class="lazyload"><br>
需要注意到这两个平面的坐标系的选择，是二维平面坐标系而不是三维坐标系统。</p>
<p><img alt="64" width="620" height="180" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206000807092-191013556.jpg" class="lazyload">这个一般用在camera calibratiion，在一个平面上放置棋盘样的平面投影到相机平面进行相机校准。</p>
<p><img alt="65" width="411" height="161" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206000834042-751859563.jpg" class="lazyload"><br>
简单旋转相机得到的两幅图像之间的关系，</p>
<p>Homography matrix的用处：</p>
<p><img alt="66" width="336" height="277" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206000906899-423435197.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>在增强现实中，使用带标记点的共面的点来估算相机的位置进而进行虚实的混合。看图片应该是用的OGRE3D引擎。</p>
<p><img alt="67" width="454" height="185" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206000936718-1633114789.jpg" class="lazyload"><br>
透视投影效果的去除和矫正。</p>
<p><img alt="68" width="266" height="222" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001003660-1249867621.jpg" class="lazyload"><br>
全景图片的缝合。</p>
<p>二.Essential matrix(本质矩阵)。</p>
<p><img alt="69" width="220" height="145" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001026857-1067704822.jpg" class="lazyload"><br>
<img alt="70" width="221" height="162" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001053907-1382548448.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="71" width="218" height="151" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001135911-2117113958.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="72" width="218" height="98" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001211466-755906042.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="73" width="221" height="145" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001234809-1821917342.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="74" width="216" height="152" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001301896-1563842587.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>以上是Essential matrix的推导过程及性质，需要注意的是这里的p,p'为齐次坐标下的点，而不是像素坐标。Canonical camera指的是相机的intrinsic参数已知。</p>
<p>三.Fundamental matrix(基础矩阵).</p>
<p><img alt="75" width="220" height="142" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001331143-581123384.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="76" width="219" height="150" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001402531-1940447926.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="77" width="218" height="141" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001501880-1436045556.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="78" width="223" height="149" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001535794-321252880.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>以上是Fundamental matrix的推导过程及性质。</p>
<p>四.Fundamental matrix和Essential matrix的关系</p>
<p><img alt="79" width="308" height="143" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001558954-1060018910.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="80" width="209" height="144" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001623193-130880856.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>需要说明的是，这里的世界坐标系的原点定义在右边相机的位置。</p>
<p>五.Eight-point Algorithm(八点算法).</p>
<p><img alt="81" width="219" height="140" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001646311-493193358.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="82" width="221" height="145" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001712012-2128190586.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="83" width="217" height="156" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001737229-1361726135.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="84" width="222" height="158" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001805394-760874845.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="85" width="220" height="159" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3730441/202512/3730441-20251206001835461-1614006512.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>八点算法用于估算Fundamental matrix，估算Fundamental matrix还有一个七点算法，感兴趣的可以在网上搜索一下，在此不再骜述。需要特别说明的是八点算法和七点算法都是用于non-calibrated camera,求解calibrated camera还有一个专门的五点算法，不过最近的研究发现，五个点也可以估算Fundamental matrix，具体请参阅CVPR2018的论文<a href="https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content_cvpr_2018/papers/Barath_Five-Point_Fundamental_Matrix_CVPR_2018_paper.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Five-point Fundamental Matrix Estimation for Uncalibrated Cameras</a></p>

</div>
